Plugins  off until you want them

  Welcome to rush. These plugins come with it. They're off until you
  want them: useful, but not for everyone all the time. Tick the ones
  you want; Settings › Plugins turns any of them on or off later.

  Messages
▍ ○ drafts             Keeps what you clear or send, so nothing ty…
  ● queue              Holds messages until the agent is free, the…
  Voice
  ○ yap                Talk instead of typing.

    Keeps what you clear or send, so nothing typed is lost.

=====
Plugins  off until you want them

  These plugins come with rush. They're off until you want them:
  useful, but not for everyone all the time. Tick the ones you want;
  Settings › Plugins turns any of them on or off later.

  Messages
  ○ drafts             Keeps what you clear or send, so nothing ty…
▍ ● queue              Holds messages until the agent is free, the…
  Voice
  ○ yap                Talk instead of typing.

    Holds messages until the agent is free, then sends them in order,
    one at a time, each when the last is answered.
